title: Cohort Throttle Bridge with Soft‑Quarantine and Automated Rollback Actors
author: Ibrahim Patel
release_notes: Introduce Cohort Throttle Bridge: opt-in beta feature for staged rollouts with soft-quarantine and automated rollback actors; per-cohort throttles and quota accounting; preserved session affinity during quarantine; metrics-gated phased rollout.
description: Motivation: Provide a lightweight middleware 'Throttle Bridge' between the rollout scheduler and the router to enforce cohort-level throttles and a soft-quarantine window during incremental rollouts. This reduces blast radius for noisy cohorts, preserves session-affinity, and enables automated rollback actions when multi-metric gates trip. Changes overview: adds a new controller (cohort-throttle-bridge), policy DSL extensions (throttle_budget, soft_quarantine_window_secs), a rollback-actor runtime that can perform snapshot-based and session-scoped reverts, metrics adapters to expose cohort-level counters, and console flags for phased rollout. Commits summary: - 1a2f3b4 Add initial bridge controller, CRD, and unit tests - 4c5d6e7 Integrate bridge into router decision path and cohort quota accounting - 7f8g9h0 Add rollback-actor runtime and snapshot reverter - a1b2c3d docs: add rollout guide and console toggle - e4f5g6h perf: microbench harness and telemetry. Files changed (high-level): rollout/controller/throttle_bridge.go (+120 -12), rollout/policy/schema.go (+48 -4), router/decision/bridge_integration.go (+60 -8), router/metrics/collector.go (+92 -10), servegraph/snapshot/reverter.go (+200 -30), tests/e2e/cohort_quarantine_test.go (+340 -12), docs/rollouts/cohort-throttle.md (+180), console/flags/cohort_throttle.toml (+12). Small snippets: rollout/policy/schema.go: added field SoftQuarantineWindowSecs int `json:"soft_quarantine_window_secs"` and ThrottleBudget struct; router/metrics/collector.go: cohortQuotaKey := fmt.Sprintf("cohort:%s:quota", cohortID). Testing notes: local unit tests pass; e2e had a flaky perf latency assertion which was rerun and passed on second run. CI summary: build: pass, unit-tests: pass, e2e: pass (after retry), lint: pass, perf-bench: warning (4% regression on synthetic burst-case flagged; within configured safety_budget). Review conversation (condensed): Ravi Kapoor: "How do we preserve session-affinity when diverting traffic to shadow/quarantine lanes?" Ibrahim Patel: "We annotate the servegraph snapshot with session token anchors and set the router to carry affinity cookies; see servegraph/snapshot/README.md updates and tests/e2e/cohort_quarantine_test.go." Elena Moreno: "Quota accounting must be per-cohort and not affect global quotas." Ibrahim Patel: "Fixed in router/metrics/collector.go — quotas are tracked by cohort ID with separate prometheus labels; added unit tests." Samir Desai: "Can rollback-actors run safely against stateful backends?" Ibrahim Patel: "Rollback-actors support session-scoped reverts and have opt-in checklists for stateful stores; documented safe modes and a dry-run switch in servegraph/snapshot/reverter.go." Requested changes: minor nits on logging verbosity and an added perf microbench; both addressed in follow-up commits. Approval: Samir approved on 2026-02-28, Elena approved 2026-03-01, Ravi gave final approval 2026-03-02. Checklist: [x] Unit tests updated and passing [x] E2E smoke tests [x] Console flag and docs [x] Perf microbench added [x] Telemetry hooks added. Backwards compatibility: new policy fields are optional; bridge is behind feature flag 'cohort_throttle_bridge' so no automatic change in behavior. Rollout plan: feature-flagged phased rollout: 10% clusters (week 1) -> 50% (week 2) -> 100% (week 4) with automated metric gates (latency p95, error-rate, cost-per-token). Automated rollback behavior: rollback-actors can be triggered by configured gates or manual playbook; they support snapshot replay and session-bounded revert to preserve user sessions. Linked work items: ENG-1349 (policy DSL), ENG-2150 (router quotas), PM-332 (product rollout plan). Release notes: "Beta: Cohort Throttle Bridge — opt-in per-cohort throttles and soft-quarantine with automated rollback actors; see docs/rollouts/cohort-throttle.md for operational guidance." Merge: merged to main via squash by merge-bot on 2026-03-03. Post-merge actions: telemetry collection enabled for 4 weeks, will auto-roll back if regressions exceed defined thresholds; follow-up ENG-2151 created for expanded observability and a widget in Console. Operational impact: enables safer A/B and canary rollouts by automatically isolating noisy cohorts and reducing manual rollbacks.
